name: LightCraft v0.9.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix Lightroom catalog import results and reduce CPU and memory use by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1406
* ci: add comfortable runtime limits to unbounded jobs by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1836
* Integration batch 36: 110 reviewed community PRs (slideshow, camera verification, translations, never-crash, UI) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1843
* DNG export and Convert / Copy as DNG write the colour a raw without matrices opens with by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1750
* Edit panel: the Reset tooltip shows the platform's shortcut, Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows and Linux by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1753
* LR-META-XMP: Retry automatic XMP sidecar writes that failed by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1772
* Never crash: Check raw data size before allocating in PEF, TIFF tiles and ARW6 (#1512) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1776
* Catalog and downloads: Don't write through a link at a temp file's name (#1502) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1779
* Faces: Drop faces made from a photo's old file when it is replaced (#1524) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1780
* LR-PREF-GENERAL: Keep the Settings window in place when switching tabs by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1782
* fix(ui): prevent search text selection from dragging the window by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1784
* cli: refuse non-object snapshot params instead of panicking by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1791
* Packaging: advertise HEIF images and repair the AppStream screenshot by @IanHollow in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1795
* codecs: decode lossless (SOF3) JPEGs correctly by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1796
* Open the active grid photo with Enter by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1797
* LRC-DEV-LOUPEOVERLAY: a layout image over the loupe (View ▸ Loupe Overlay) by @BuonBreda in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1798
* LR-CROP-STRAIGHTEN: turning a crop shrinks it about its centre instead of swapping it for the largest crop (#1794) by @guillehr2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1804
* ui: render the Show All Masks overlay in zoom windows by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1808
* Fix crop.rotateAspect turning a zero-size crop into a NaN rect by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1813
* Keep crop finite when crop.set gets a huge rect by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1816
* LR-META-XMP: radial masks keep their inside/outside from Lightroom (fixes #1815) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1817
* LR-LIB-REMOVE-ALBUM: removing a photo from an album keeps it in its folder (fixes #1805) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1818
* LR-IMP-LOCAL: browsing a Local folder keeps or picks the active photo (fixes #1447) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1820
* Detail: snap the 100% view to whole screen pixels by @john01px2022 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1831
* LR-VIEW-BEFOREAFTER: both panes animate together during click zoom (stacked on #1747) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1832
* CI-RUST195: keep strict Clippy clean on Rust 1.95 by @Myrarc in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1835
* Keywords panel: sections fold, Add keyword offers the library's keywords, and removals say what they touched by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1166
* i18n: add Czech (cs) interface language by @Losminek in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1190
* Nix: nix build and nix develop work again on NixOS by @dev-null-undefined in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1211
* KEY-SLIDER-NUDGE: scrolling sideways over a slider adjusts it by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1465
* LR-RAW-NEF: Coolpix P7000 NRW files decode without stripes and with their white balance by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1467
* build: automatically include CJK fonts and fix Windows packaging compatibility by @draco892 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1479
* LR-VIEW-PHOTOGRID: a mouse-wheel notch scrolls a third of the grid or filmstrip by @MarkusFriedel in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1482
* LR-EDIT-DETAIL-NR: noise reduction works in the original's pixels, so previews match the full-size render scaled down (fixes #960) by @atmikshetty in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1489
* KEYC-RATING: backtick cycles the flag; Cmd+Up / Cmd+Down raise / lower it by @atmikshetty in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1490
* LR-LIB-PEOPLE: rename a person across the library (#1444) by @Hossamvs in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1510
* LR-EDIT-EFFECTS-DEHAZE: raster::morph square min / max filters (split from #1286) by @mattsivak in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1521
* Fix range-mask handle drags and color sampling settings by @nevicia2010-hub in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1538
* LR-IMP-LOCAL: Forget untouched records of deleted files when browsing a folder again (#1392) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1547
* LR-BEHAV-GPU: Turn GPU rendering off after the GPU is lost while running (#1337) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1548
* LR-MERGE-PANO: Keep panoramas at full resolution when memory allows (#1455) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1549
* Library grids: Home/End and Shift+Left/Right selection keys; Cmd+O opens a library, Shift+H visualizes HDR by @eliets2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1555
* LR-LIB-STACK: deleting a stacked photo drops it from the stack so i/n badges update (fixes #1493) by @squareSphere29 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1556
* LR-META-INFO: Show the lens for Nikon DSLR raws by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1590
* LR-IMP-DEVICE: Show the import review when a card is connected by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1601
* LR-MERGE-HDR: merged DNGs declare the white balance their source shows (follow-up to #1123) by @alvarohn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1613
* LR-BEHAV-WINDOW: the window opens at the size it was left at, zoomed if it was by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1625
* Protect originals and preserve existing files when exporting presets by @SarimSyed in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1637
* LR-LIB-SMARTALBUM: a view can hold its photos until it is refreshed by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1656
* PERF-EDIT: an edit is followed from what it touched, not worked out from every photo (stacked on #1656) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1660
* PERF-EDIT: a smart album's count follows an edit, asking only the photos it touched (stacked on #1660) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1662
* LRC-LIB-PEOPLE: a double click on an unnamed face opens its photo in the loupe by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1665
* Import: find sidecars whose photo extension or .xmp differs in case by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1686
* fix(mcp): stop stdio cleanly after output failure by @euisuh in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1688
* Loupe: the info overlay's shadow is dark, not a second white copy of the text by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1693
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: decode EOS R6 Mark II C-RAW with adaptive QP up to 175 by @cookingwithsimon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1694
* Metadata: read the Panasonic lens name from maker note tag 0x0051 (#1671) by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1703
* LR-PROF-BROWSER: long profile names are cut short in a narrow panel by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1710
* LR-MERGE-HDR: moving clipped highlights stay, less memory, and HDR for Each Bracket Set by @dev-null-undefined in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1715
* Colour grading wheels: vivid sRGB rim fading evenly to neutral by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1719
* MCP-CONTROL: validate remote reply framing and IDs (#1716) by @G6bill in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1722
* Perf: DNG Deflate tiles at level 1, 4.8–7× faster writes for 3–12 % more bytes by @dev-null-undefined in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1731
* render --settings applies the preset in a .lcpreset, and refuses files it can't read by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1733
* Lightroom import: raise catalog/WAL size limit from 1 GiB to 4 GiB by @vpjl in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1738
* catalog: slice captured dates on char boundaries so non-ASCII dates don't panic by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1741
* packaging: RPM requires library sonames, so openSUSE can install it by @tydude001 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1744
* Before/After: a click on the Before view zooms in on the point clicked by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1747
* gpu: init-marker tests use their own scope counter so parallel device tests cannot join them (#1721) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1758
* Top bar: in full screen the left buttons move into the traffic lights' space by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1767
* Widen offline reverse-geocoding longitude search at high latitudes by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1769
* Never crash: Write preview cache files from one bounded writer (#1522) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1777
* raw: check maker-note crop bounds with checked_add by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1792
* engine: refuse negative indices instead of targeting element 0 by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1793
* LRC-SS-PLAYBACK: slideshow playback: fades, random order, repeat, previews prepared in advance, playback controls by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/796
* Use consistent arrows throughout the app and clarify histogram controls by @shurkanTwo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/806
* Slideshow layout, options and backdrop: composed slides in playback and a live preview (LRC-SS-LAYOUT/OPTIONS/BACKDROP, stacked on #796) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/808
* Slideshow overlays: identity plate, rating stars, text with tokens, watermark (LRC-SS-OVERLAYS, stacked on #808) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/821
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: Sony ILCE-7RM6 embedded lens corrections (distortion applied; CA and vignetting parsed) by @dev-null-undefined in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/824
* Slideshow intro and ending screens (LRC-SS-TITLES, stacked on #821) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/904
* Slideshow templates: built-ins of our own, user templates, browser with hover preview (LRC-SS-TEMPLATES, stacked on #904) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/912
* Slideshow export to PDF, JPEG sequence and AV1 video (LRC-SS-EXPORT, stacked on #912) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/929
* Rotate left/right turns the crop with the image instead of cutting it (#962) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/966
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: recheck stale preview-only raws when a library opens (#662) by @valenfys in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/974
* Export: "Same folder as original photo" destination (#956) by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/996
* LR-VIEW-ZOOM: slider drags stay sharp where the GPU keeps up (#330) by @mattsivak in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1009
* LR-EXP-DNGOPT: lossy DNG export by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1010
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: verify 22 more CR3 bodies; EOS R6 Mark III white balance by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1029
* LR-MASK-BRUSH: pen pressure scales brush size and flow by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1033
* LR-BEHAV-ACCESS: canvas tools by keyboard (stacked on #1023) by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1038
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: verify 117 Nikon and Fujifilm bodies on CC0 files by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1045
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: measured image area for Nikon bodies without CropArea by @robmdunn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1053
* LR-MASK-EFFECTS: local adjustment presets with Lightroom Classic import by @OneSlips in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1062
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: verify 97 Canon CR2, Pentax and Ricoh models on CC0 files by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1081
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: decode Epson ERF by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1087
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: verify 21 Sony and Leica models on CC0 files by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1096
* Add complete Polish (pl) localization by @neronek22 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1100
* UI: align Local folder rows, paint dock gaps, bottom-align the tool strip (#1097, #1098, #1099) by @mattsivak in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1102
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: import and decode Mamiya MEF (stacked on #1087) by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1105
* Preview cache: cached thumbnails are no longer taken for the person's photos (#610, #1066) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1106
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: verify 17 uncompressed Olympus and Samsung models on CC0 files by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1108
* L10N: fill the de, es, fr, ja and uk catalogs (gap 21) by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1111
* docs: add user docs in docs/user by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1180
* LR-EDIT-SECTION-SOLO: Solo Mode for Edit sections by @mattsivak in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1308
* Fonts: finish Thai fallback delivery for desktop and web releases by @LabDennis in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1311
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: property tests for the CRX decoder by @eliets2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1461
* LR-IMP-FORMATS: CI-enforce the unsupported CRX variants listed in docs/cr3.md by @eliets2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1462
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: Canon EOS R7 / R6 Mark II calibrate measurements by @cookingwithsimon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1466
* KEY-HIDEPINS: Tool Overlay modes (Auto / Always / Selected / Never) for spot and mask pins, Shift+H cycles them (fixes #224) by @atmikshetty in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1473
* KEYC-COMPARE: = and - make the grid thumbnails larger and smaller by @atmikshetty in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1491
* People: confirm suggested faces above a chosen score (#1442) by @Th4nat0s in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1495
* LR-EXP-QUALITY: Use optimized Huffman tables for JPEG exports (#1373) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1540
* fix(rawinfo): report failed validation batches through exit status by @FooVoo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1696
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: bundled Sony ILCA-99M2 camera profile by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1019
* Integration batch 37: 20 rebased community PRs (print module, decode speed-ups, camera coverage, Italian) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1852
* feat(xtask): #1037 ci reports the machine, GPU adapters and skipped tests by @THEtheChad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1135
* perf(catalog): #1136 index stacks and album membership; no per-photo list scans at 100k by @THEtheChad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1138
* LR-EDIT-OPTICS-PROFILE: decode Sony shading, CA and distortion tables (nothing new applied), plus a BigTIFF overflow fix by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1176
* i18n: translate dialog notes, toasts and tooltips by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1298
* DNG: fit tone and chroma curves to the embedded preview (#1277) by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1316
* Perf: 64 MP raws decode faster (AHD 1.7×, ARW6 decode, camera-look colour 1.9×, no full-size copy), same pixels by @dev-null-undefined in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1320
* LR-IMP-CAMERA-COVERAGE: verify 30 more camera models on public raw files by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1327
* LR-IMP-PROFILES: Presets apply the imported profile they name (#1001) by @cookingwithsimon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1469
* LR-RAW-NEF: stretch non-square pixels (Nikon D1X/D1H) to square by @radialmonster in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1475
* fix(export): a metadata/sharpen/conflict value that passes validation is the one exported by @sperea in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1705
* Edit panel: the histogram clipping buttons stay clear of the hovered scroll bar by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1708
* LRC-LIB-KEYWORDS: the Keyword List holds its place as the Keywords box above it changes by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1755
* LR-BEHAV-EMPTY-STATES: an empty library leads to Import by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1761
* LR-PROF-DROPDOWN: a long profile name no longer widens the Edit panel by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1762
* Commands: Refuse malformed photo ids instead of using the selection (#1506) by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1773
* Dialogs: the confirm button is on the right, filled when it is the next step by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1802
* Buttons: one component with kinds, sizes and icons (stacked on #1802) by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1810
* Add Italian interface translation by @GabrielePecchioli in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1198
* Print module: picture and custom packages, printer colour management, colour-managed PDF (gap 15) by @atmikshetty in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1215
* LR-MERGE-PANO: a panorama or HDR merge of raws keeps the as-shot white balance of its frames by @eliets2 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1471
* Integration batch 38: 6 rebased community PRs (Nikon camera profiles, lens-corrected colour, HDR frame order, focus points) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1857
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: Match the camera look against lens-corrected JPEGs by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1586
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: Add a bundled Nikon Z 6II camera profile by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1592
* LR-MERGE-HDR: frame-order independent merges, and no magenta bias next to clipped pixels by @alvarohn in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1614
* LRC-LIB-LIBFOLDERS: drag photos from the grid onto a Folders row to move them there by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1834
* Show the camera's focus point (Sony α1, A7S III) and zoom to it (#1480) by @bitshiftza in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1487
* LR-PROF-CAMERACOLOR: Add bundled Nikon Z 8 and D5300 camera profiles by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1595
* Integration batch 39: 4 rebased community PRs (Georgian, slider scrub and reset hints, straight brush lines) and the Windows ARM64 font pin by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1865
* LR-MASK-BRUSH: Shift-click draws a straight brush stroke from the last one by @endthestart in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1829
* KEY-SLIDER-RESET: a slider's name and thumb say a double-click resets it (fixes #1436) by @atmikshetty in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1474
* KEY-SLIDER-SCRUB: drag a slider's value sideways to scrub it by @good-news-everyone in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1604
* i18n: Georgian (ka) interface language by @devius in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1823
* Integration batch 40: 3 rebased community PRs (GPU face detection, soft-proof zoom windows, faster folder sync) and restored tracker rows by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1867
* LR-VIEW-ZOOM: soft proofing gets zoom windows; 1:1 tested equal to export by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1027
* PERF-SYNC: a Synchronize Folder scan reads off the folder's listing whether a photo and its sidecar are there by @nledford in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1602
* Faces: GPU (wgpu) path for detection and recognition convolutions by @emmertex in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/1663
* ci: refactor workflows to use storytold/craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/967
* Follow catalog paths only on this computer or the catalog's share by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2175
* Open Original: only file types LightCraft reads reach the system opener by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2199
* Fix offline reverse geocoding for cities at longitude exactly 180 by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2061
* Fix Assisted Culling bursts that cross midnight at month end by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2095
* Search words with an unknown field prefix as plain text by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2099
* Keep the zone when shifting a capture time without seconds by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2146
* Codecs: clip positive-infinity float samples to white (#1952, item 6) by @AlexChambers in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/2071
